errors.text_span: der lila Balken in den Jahren 2015 bis 2020 und 2023 bis 2025 höher ist als der hellblaue Balken
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the purple bar is higher than the blue bar for 2015; the figure shows the purple bar (10.59 in description, but actually 10.82) is higher than the blue bar (8.50) only from 2016 onward, not 2015.
The description does not mention the exact values for the purple bars in the intermediate years (e.g., 2016-2024), only the start and end values.
The phrase 'referenzwertkompatiblen Mindestlohns' is unclear and not aligned with the figure's legend, which uses '60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten'.
